description: This file defines the Image class in the Drupal core, representing an image file with methods for validation, manipulation, and metadata retrieval, utilizing an image toolkit interface.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Represents an image file with methods for validation, resizing, cropping, and other manipulations, using an image toolkit interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Image object with a toolkit and optional source path, setting up the image and its size if valid.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the image is valid via the toolkit.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the image.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the image.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the file size in bytes.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the image.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source path of the image.

methods.name: getToolkitId
methods.description: Returns the plugin ID of the image toolkit.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the image to a destination, updating file size and permissions.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies an image operation via the toolkit.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new image with specified dimensions and options.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts the image to a different extension.

methods.name: crop
methods.description: Crops the image at specified coordinates and size.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the image to specified dimensions.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotates the image by a specified number of degrees.

methods.name: scaleAndCrop
methods.description: Scales and crops the image to specified dimensions.
